name: poolparty-sanity
help: Query-only PoolParty check (no inject). Variant 8 object; pid only.
long_help: Does not inject. Opens the PID and checks that variant 8 can run: live x64 process (not WOW64), a Windows thread pool, IRTimer and timer-queue pointers. Prints PASS or FAIL. No shellcode, no remote memory write. For variants 4-7 use the CNA/Havoc/OC2 wrappers. Then inject with PoolPartyBof.

arguments.name: pid
arguments.desc: PID of a process (variant 8 implied by this object).
